statement: A supersession target resolves by the first four-digit run in the TARGET'S FILENAME (REC-043); an unresolvable reference is dropped silently (REC-044).
note: 0044-new-approach.md declares THREE supersession references. Only ADR-0009 resolves: its target filename carries a four-digit run. ADR-7's record exists and is a valid record, but its FILENAME (no-number-here.md) carries no four-digit run, so it is not addressable as a target -- the deliberate asymmetry with REC-013. ADR-0777 names no record in the directory. Both unresolvable references are dropped SILENTLY: exactly 1 edge, and no error.
